title: Two Hands

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Big hand plays the low one,

sections.name: Together
lines: Me and you, me and you.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Two hands, two hands,
Your hand and mine.
Low note, high note,
Play in time.

[Listen again]
Big hand plays the low one,
Little hand plays high.
Put them both together,
Hear the music fly.

[Together]
Play with me, one, two,
Me and you, me and you.
Low note, high note,
That's our tune.

[One more verse]
Grown-up keeps the beat, beat,
Child plays the song.
Every hand is helping,
Everyone belongs.

[All together]
Two hands, two hands,
Your hand and mine.
Low note, high note,
Every time.

title: Papa's Low Note

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen
lines: I play all the high ones,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Papa's note is deep and big,
My notes skip and hop along,

sections.name: Together
lines: You go low and I go high,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Papa taps it on the one,
I can play my tune on top,

sections.name: All together
lines: We made music, both of us,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Papa plays the low note,
Bom, bom, bom.
I play all the high ones,
Here they come.

[Listen again]
Papa's note is deep and big,
Like a sleepy bear.
My notes skip and hop along,
Floating in the air.

[Together]
Play with me, Papa,
Bom, and then ting.
You go low and I go high,
Hear us sing.

[One more verse]
Papa taps it on the one,
Steady as a clock.
I can play my tune on top,
Tick, and then tock.

[All together]
Papa plays the low note,
Bom, bom, bom.
We made music, both of us,
Now we're done.

title: Mumma Hums

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen
lines: I sing on top of it,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Mumma's hum is warm and soft,
My little song sits on top,
Not too big, not too small.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: In the kitchen, in the car,
Every time she hums the low,

sections.name: All together
lines: Thank you for the hum, Mumma,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Mumma hums a low hum,
Mmm, mmm, mmm.
I sing on top of it,
La, la, la.

[Listen again]
Mumma's hum is warm and soft,
Like a cosy shawl.
My little song sits on top,
Not too big, not too small.

[Together]
Hum with me, Mumma,
Low and slow.
I'll sing the high part,
Here we go.

[One more verse]
In the kitchen, in the car,
Mumma hums along.
Every time she hums the low,
I can sing my song.

[All together]
Mumma hums a low hum,
Mmm, mmm, mmm.
Thank you for the hum, Mumma,
La, la, la.

title: Dadu's Big Drum

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Dadu plays it one and three,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Dadu used to play like this
Now he plays the drum with me,

sections.name: All together
lines: Thank you, Dadu, one more time,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Dadu has a big drum,
Boom and boom.
I have little bells,
Ting in the room.

[Listen again]
Dadu plays it one and three,
Boom and then boom.
I play every note between,
Zoom, zoom, zoom.

[Together]
Play with me, Dadu,
Boom, ting, boom.
Big drum, little bells,
Fill the room.

[One more verse]
Dadu used to play like this
When Papa was small.
Now he plays the drum with me,
Best of all.

[All together]
Dadu has a big drum,
Boom and boom.
Thank you, Dadu, one more time,
Boom, boom, boom!

title: Rocking Chair

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

lyrics:
[Listen]
Rocking chair,
Back and forth.
Low on one,
High for more.

[Listen again]
Creak, creak, creak,
Soft and slow.
Grown-up low,
Me up high.

[Together]
Rock with me,
One, two, three.
Low and high,
You and me.

[One more verse]
Window light,
Golden, warm.
Rocking chair,
Safe from storm.

[All together]
Rocking chair,
Slowing down.
Sleepy song,
Gentle sound.

title: Big Step, Little Step

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Big step, boom, little step, tap,
Big steps on the low note,
Little steps on top, you know.

sections.name: Together
lines: Walk with me, big and small,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Up the hill, the big steps slow,
Wait for me, I'm coming too,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Big step, little step,
Walking down the street.
Grown-up takes the big steps,
I take little feet.

[Listen again]
Big step, boom, little step, tap,
Hand in hand we go.
Big steps on the low note,
Little steps on top, you know.

[Together]
Walk with me, big and small,
Big step, little, all.
Low note, high notes,
One, two, three, four.

[One more verse]
Up the hill, the big steps slow,
Little steps run fast.
Wait for me, I'm coming too,
Here I am at last.

[All together]
Big step, little step,
Now we're home again.
Big and little walking,
Best of friends.

title: Kitchen Duet

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Big pot bubbles, blub, blub, blub,
Cooking up a song for two,

sections.name: Together
lines: Cook with me, stir and tap,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Smells so good, the dal is done,
Grown-up keeps the beat for us,

sections.name: All together
lines: Thank you for the kitchen duet,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Grown-up stirs the big pot,
Swish on the one.
I tap the little spoons,
Kitchen fun!

[Listen again]
Big pot bubbles, blub, blub, blub,
Little spoons go ting.
Cooking up a song for two,
Hear the kitchen sing.

[Together]
Cook with me, stir and tap,
Big pot, little spoon.
Low note, high notes,
Kitchen tune.

[One more verse]
Smells so good, the dal is done,
Rice is fluffy, white.
Grown-up keeps the beat for us,
Dinner time tonight.

[All together]
Grown-up stirs the big pot,
Swish on the one.
Thank you for the kitchen duet,
Now let's eat, yum!

title: Goodnight Duet

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, soft and slow,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Low note, high note, one last time,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Goodnight, goodnight,
Low note, soft.
Goodnight, goodnight,
High note, off.

[Listen again]
Grown-up plays the sleepy note,
Slow and very deep.
I play little twinkles,
Counting stars to sleep.

[Together]
Play with me, soft and slow,
Goodnight, high and low.
Close your eyes, nearly there,
Off we go.

[One more verse]
Teddy's sleeping, lamp is dim,
Blanket warm and tight.
Low note, high note, one last time,
Saying sweet goodnight.

[All together]
Goodnight, goodnight,
Low note, soft.
Goodnight, goodnight,
Lights off.

title: One Family

styles: soft children's choir with a warm grown-up voice
a steady low note on the first beat of each bar, like a grown-up playing along

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Big ones keep the low beat,

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, all of us,

lyrics:
[Listen]
One family, one song,
Everybody plays along.
Low notes, high notes,
All belong.

[Listen again]
Mumma, Papa, Ba and Dadu,
Every hand can play.
Big ones keep the low beat,
Little ones lead the way.

[Together]
Play with me, all of us,
One family, one song.
Low notes, high notes,
All day long.

[One more verse]
Cousins, aunties, uncles too,
Gather round and see.
Everybody playing,
One big family.

[All together]
One family, one song,
Now we take a bow.
Low notes, high notes,
We can play it now!
